title: Superset Permission and Role Change Audit
dataSources: Superset logs (`superset:app`) and REST API events.
app: Superset application and Celery worker logs via UF; Superset REST API via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=superset:app (action="*role*" OR action="*permission*")
| stats count as changes, values(action) as actions by user
| sort - changes
description: Audits Superset events that grant, revoke or modify permissions and roles, giving a change trail for least-privilege reviews and incident investigation.
value: Unreviewed permission changes are a leading cause of data-access incidents; an audit trail for Superset supports governance and rollback.
implementation: Ingest Superset admin/audit events; schedule daily and alert on privilege grants made outside an approved change window.
visualization: Table of actor by change count with actions, timeline.
grandmaExplanation: We keep a record of who changes access and permissions in Superset so unexpected changes can be traced.
